Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "for thursday morning please send the watering rota to Saskia not Bram because she is covering the east bench before the volunteer group arrives. the first pass should start at seven and use the blue hose for the seedling tables, but leave the new trays by the door until Leila checks their labels. the tomatoes in bay three need two full cans each, and the pepper pots need one can shared across the whole shelf. after that, whoever is on the rota should check the moisture card clipped to the basil rack and write the reading in the green notebook. if the top line is still marked dry, water those pots lightly and check them again before lunch. don't move the little fan beside the cucumber bed, since it is keeping the leaves dry after yesterday's leak. the spare hose nozzle is in the drawer under the potting bench, and the brass key for the side gate is hanging on the hook by the sink. please ask Saskia to message me if any row is blocked or if the tank falls below a quarter. the afternoon shift can refill it, but only after they finish watering the hanging baskets near the glasshouse entrance. leave the printed rota on the noticeboard when you're done so the weekend crew can see the changes.", "output": "For Thursday morning, please send the watering rota to Saskia, not Bram, because she is covering the east bench before the volunteer group arrives. The first pass should start at seven and use the blue hose for the seedling tables, but leave the new trays by the door until Leila checks their labels. The tomatoes in bay three need two full cans each, and the pepper pots need one can shared across the whole shelf. After that, whoever is on the rota should check the moisture card clipped to the basil rack and write the reading in the green notebook. If the top line is still marked dry, water those pots lightly and check them again before lunch. Don't move the little fan beside the cucumber bed, since it is keeping the leaves dry after yesterday's leak. The spare hose nozzle is in the drawer under the potting bench, and the brass key for the side gate is hanging on the hook by the sink. Please ask Saskia to message me if any row is blocked or if the tank falls below a quarter. The afternoon shift can refill it, but only after they finish watering the hanging baskets near the glasshouse entrance. Leave the printed rota on the noticeboard when you're done so the weekend crew can see the changes."}]
